reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name AS product_a, s.product_name AS product_b
FROM products p
JOIN products s ON s.product_id = p.sister_product_id
WHERE p.product_id < s.product_id

solver.query:
WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT LEAST(product_id, sister_product_id) AS a_id, GREATEST(product_id, sister_product_id) AS b_id
  FROM products
  WHERE sister_product_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.product_name AS product_a, b.product_name AS product_b
FROM pairs
JOIN products a ON a.product_id = pairs.a_id
JOIN products b ON b.product_id = pairs.b_id
